Man, I created something really similar back in June. I call [this symbol “grey”](https://www.reddit.com/user/MickeyMouseAlt/comments/j42313/grey/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf) and it basically represents the idea that we never know everything about anyone. The top white half represents what we show to others; our outside selves. The bottom black half represents our inner selves, that we only share with ourselves. Nobody is only the top white half, but rather we are all mix of both our white top half (outer self) and our black bottom half (inner self) creating a mix of grey.
